smells.finding: self_test() grew 201 -> 324 lines in this gate (+123, measured by AST end_lineno-lineno at 6d35fe2 vs HEAD) and frame_verdict() is 96 lines carrying a two-arm RESOLVED/DEGRADED branch plus a shared no-backing tail. Neither is a blocker: self_test() is straight-line with no branching or state, so the design problem the smell warns about (hard to reason about, hard to change safely) does not actually bite, and every assertion is individually named via _check(). frame_verdict() would read better with the two arms extracted (resolved_problems() / degraded_problems()), which would also let each arm be tested without constructing a receipt. Recorded as an observation for a future pass, not rework for this gate.

No production classes added by g2. The only classes in map_orient.py are the g1 dataclasses (Candidate, RootProof, Orientation), untouched here. New classes in tests/ are unittest.TestCase groupings, which is the file's existing organising convention.

The RESOLVED-arm and DEGRADED-arm refusal strings in frame_verdict() are genuinely different messages about different contracts, not copies. New tests reuse the existing shared fixture helpers (resolved_repo/frame/verify_frame) rather than re-rolling repo setup per test.
The new pure helpers take exactly the data they operate on. No function reaches repeatedly into another object's internals in preference to its own.

(receipt, frame_text, inventory) travels together into frame_verdict() and its results (first_line, code, problems) travel together into render_frame_report() -- a textbook clump that a FrameCheck value object would absorb.

override.repo_standard: scripts/map_orient.py module convention: every checker docstring opens with 'PURE.' and the module ships a --self-test falsification floor (a g1-mandated, already-APPROVED deliverable; g1-implementer-handoff.md line 146).
override.reason: The PURE-functions-over-primitives shape is what lets --self-test exercise every verdict path in-process with dict/str/tuple literals and no filesystem or fixture. Introducing a parameter object would put a constructor between the floor and the logic it falsifies, weakening the exact property this module exists to guarantee. The documented standard subordinates the smell.

override.repo_standard: scripts/map_orient.py module docstring sections '--- reserved stdout literals ---' and the FROZEN exit-code vocabulary (0/10/11/12/13), consumed by the checklist engine as a `kind: command` postcondition -- i.e. across a process boundary, as text on stdout and an integer exit status.
override.reason: These values ARE the wire contract with an external consumer; their literalness is the feature, and the module already pins them via RESERVED_FIRST_LINES + OCCUPIED_EXIT_CODES with tests asserting the first stdout line is always a reserved literal. An enum would add an indirection over values whose whole purpose is to be compared as literals by another process. Verified independently: the exit-code block is byte-identical to 6d35fe2, so g2 introduced no new primitive vocabulary.

override.repo_standard: scripts/install_constellation.py SKILL_SCRIPT_BUNDLES / SCRIPT_RUNTIME_COMPANIONS contract, restated in the comment g2 added at the commander bundle entry: a bundled script is copied as an individual .py into each skill directory, and any sibling module it loads at runtime must be declared as a companion (pinned by tests/test_install_constellation.py).

smells.finding: No a.b().c().d() navigation introduced. Path operations are single-hop and results are bound to locals before use.

substitute_label(entry) is a module-level helper with NO production consumer. Verified by AST reachability from the three real subcommands (cmd_orient / cmd_verify_orientation / cmd_verify_frame) with self_test blocked as a traversal node, and by a whole-repo grep: its only three call sites are inside self_test() itself (map_orient.py:1575, :1580, :1585). Nothing anywhere reads the `source` key it decodes -- that key is WRITTEN at map_orient.py:1126 and never read back. This is generality built for a consumer that does not exist, and it is the same defect class the handoff named as a BLOCK (a helper reachable only from its own test). Confirmed by mutation: forcing substitute_label to return LABEL_KNOWN_FALLBACK unconditionally was killed ONLY by test_self_test_floor_passes -- no behavioural test outside the self-test moved.

The new comments explain WHY, not what: the road-not-to-take on verify-frame at context, the 'AS CITED, not normalized' rationale at the refusal site, and the SKILL_SCRIPT_BUNDLES comment stating that the absent companions entry is a checked fact rather than an omission. These are design rationale that the code cannot express, not apology for unclear code.
